name: AgencyBoost Lite
author: shashank23jan

sections.description:
AgencyBoost Lite is a complete free SEO and marketing plugin for WordPress agencies and businesses.

Free SEO Features (Version 2.0):

On-Page SEO Meta Box
* Appears on every page, post and custom post type inside the WordPress editor
* Meta title with live character counter (green at 60 chars, red if too long)
* Meta description with quality indicator (120-160 chars recommended)
* Meta keywords field
* Focus keyword field
* Live Google search snippet preview that updates as you type
* Index / NoIndex / Follow / NoFollow control per page
* Open Graph title, description and image (Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp)
* Twitter Card tags (title, description, image)
* Canonical URL control per page
* All settings saved automatically on post save – no extra steps

XML Sitemap Generator
* Auto-generates sitemap.xml at yoursite.com/sitemap.xml
* Sitemap index with per post-type sub-sitemaps
* Automatically pings Google every time you publish content
* Pages marked NoIndex are automatically excluded from sitemap
* Choose which post types to include from settings
* 12-hour transient cache for performance

Robots.txt Manager
* Visual robots.txt editor inside WordPress admin – no FTP needed
* Quick-add rules for common scenarios
* One-click blocking for AI crawlers: GPTBot (ChatGPT), ClaudeBot (Claude), CCBot, anthropic-ai
* Reset to sensible defaults in one click
* Works with WordPress virtual robots.txt (note: physical robots.txt files on server take priority)

Lead Capture Popup
* Exit-intent trigger (fires when visitor moves mouse to close tab)
* Delay trigger (fires after X seconds)
* Captures name, email and phone number
* Automatic lead scoring – business emails score higher
* CSV export of all captured leads
* CRM webhook – works with Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel, HubSpot

Analytics Tracking Injection
* GA4 Measurement ID – no theme editing needed
* Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Google Search Console verification meta tag
* Microsoft Clarity session recording
* Meta Pixel (Facebook advertising)
* TikTok Pixel
* Hotjar heatmaps

Dashboard
* Setup checklist with progress bar
* SEO status overview for recent pages
* Lead metrics and recent leads table
* Quick action links to all features

Upgrade to Pro to unlock:
* Schema Markup auto-injection (Organisation, Article, BreadcrumbList, Website)
* LLMs.txt Generator (/llms.txt and /llms-full.txt for AI search indexing)
* AI Content Engine – generate AEO, GEO and E-E-A-T optimised content with 8 AI providers
* Keyword Intelligence – intent-based research, PAA questions, content briefs
* GA4 Analytics Dashboard – real traffic data inside WordPress
* Local SEO Schema – JSON-LD for Google Maps ranking
* PDF Client Reports – white-label with email delivery
* Email SMTP – SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo, Amazon SES

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to third-party services only when the site owner enters their credentials in Settings. No data is sent by default.

Google Analytics 4

Tracks visitors and page views. Sends browser and session data on every page load.
When: Only when a GA4 Measurement ID is entered in Settings.
Provider: Google LLC
Terms: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Tag Manager

Loads tracking tags. Sends page URL and container ID on every page load.
When: Only when a GTM Container ID is entered in Settings.
Provider: Google LLC
Terms: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Microsoft Clarity

Records sessions and heatmaps. Sends mouse movements, clicks and page URL on every page load.
When: Only when a Clarity Project ID is entered in Settings.
Provider: Microsoft Corporation
Terms: https://clarity.microsoft.com/terms
Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

Meta Pixel

Tracks conversions for Facebook and Instagram ads. Sends page views and browser data on every page load.
When: Only when a Meta Pixel ID is entered in Settings.
Provider: Meta Platforms, Inc.
Terms: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

TikTok Pixel

Tracks events for TikTok ads. Sends page views and device data on every page load.
When: Only when a TikTok Pixel ID is entered in Settings.
Provider: TikTok Inc.
Terms: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/terms-of-service/en
Privacy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/privacy-policy/en

Hotjar

Records sessions and heatmaps. Sends mouse movements, clicks and scroll data on every page load.
When: Only when a Hotjar Site ID is entered in Settings.
Provider: Hotjar Ltd.
Terms: https://www.hotjar.com/legal/policies/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://www.hotjar.com/legal/policies/privacy/

Google Search Console

Verifies site ownership via a meta tag. No data is sent by the plugin.
When: Only when a GSC verification code is entered in Settings.
Provider: Google LLC
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

None of these services are active by default. The site owner must enter their own credentials to enable them and is responsible for obtaining user consent where required by applicable law (GDPR, CCPA etc).
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > search for AgencyBoost
  2. Install and activate
  3. Go to AgencyBoost > On-Page SEO to see your pages SEO status
  4. Edit any page or post – the AgencyBoost SEO meta box appears below the editor
  5. Go to AgencyBoost > Sitemap and click Generate & Ping Google
  6. Go to Settings > Permalinks and click Save Changes (this activates the sitemap URL)
  7. Go to AgencyBoost > Analytics Setup to add your tracking IDs
sections.faq:
Does it replace Rank Math or Yoast SEO?

For most agencies and businesses yes. AgencyBoost v2 covers on-page meta tags, sitemap, robots.txt, Open Graph, canonical URLs, NoIndex control, and (in Pro) schema markup. The one thing not yet included is keyword position tracking in WordPress which is on the v3 roadmap.

Will it conflict with Rank Math or Yoast if both are active?

Deactivate Rank Math or Yoast before enabling AgencyBoost SEO features to avoid duplicate meta tags. Lead capture and analytics features can run alongside any other plugin.

Does the sitemap URL work immediately after activation?

Go to Settings > Permalinks and click Save Changes after activating the plugin. This flushes rewrite rules and makes sitemap.xml available immediately.

What happens if a physical robots.txt file exists on my server?

WordPress cannot override a physical robots.txt file. The AgencyBoost editor only works with WordPress virtual robots.txt. If a physical file exists, edit it via FTP or cPanel File Manager directly.

What is LLMs.txt?

LLMs.txt is an emerging standard that tells AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity what your website is about. AgencyBoost Pro generates this automatically. Available in Pro.

Is lead capture really free with no limits?

Yes. Lead capture and all SEO features are completely free with no usage limits.

Where are leads stored?

All leads are stored in your own WordPress database. Nothing is sent to our servers.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • FIX: JS SyntaxError resolved – use wp_json_encode for safe variable output, removed inline confirm with quotes conflict

2.0.9

  • FIX: Dry Run and Live Migration buttons now work correctly – JS rewritten as global functions, moved outside form element

2.0.8

  • FIX: Import Dry Run and Live Migration buttons now work – nonce generated inline, no dependency on AGENLI JS object

2.0.7

  • FIX: Import page now defaults to only Posts and Pages (not templates/builders)
  • FIX: Count correctly shows posts+pages only, with total in brackets
  • FIX: AJAX nonce fallback added for reliability

2.0.6

  • FIX: Import Dry Run now shows results instantly via AJAX (no page refresh, no timeout on large sites)
  • FIX: Live Migration runs via AJAX with progress bar
  • BASE: Built on stable 2.0.2 — no wizard, no other changes

2.0.2

  • FIX: Import / Migrate page now accessible in Lite version (menu registration fixed)

2.0.1

  • NEW: Import from Rank Math — migrate all SEO titles, descriptions, focus keywords, robots, canonical URLs and OG data in one click with dry-run preview
  • FIX: Sitemap URL (/sitemap.xml) now works reliably via direct REQUEST_URI detection — no longer dependent on WordPress rewrite rules
  • FIX: Robots.txt now detects physical file on server and offers direct write button
  • NEW: Sitemap exclusion controls — exclude specific pages/posts from sitemap per post type
  • IMPROVED: Robots.txt page shows green/yellow status for physical file detection

2.0.0

  • Added On-Page SEO meta box on every page, post and custom post type
  • Added meta title, description, keywords, focus keyword per page
  • Added live Google snippet preview with character counter
  • Added Index / NoIndex / Follow / NoFollow per page
  • Added Open Graph and Twitter Card tags per page
  • Added Canonical URL control per page
  • Added XML Sitemap Generator with sitemap index
  • Added automatic Google ping on content publish
  • Added Robots.txt Manager with visual editor
  • Added quick-add rules for AI crawler blocking (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot)
  • Added Analytics Setup page for GA4, GTM, Clarity, Meta Pixel, TikTok, Hotjar
  • Added LLMs.txt Generator (Pro – /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt)
  • Added Schema Markup auto-injection (Pro – Organisation, Article, BreadcrumbList, Website)
  • Added License page
  • Improved Dashboard with SEO status overview and setup checklist
  • All prefixes updated to agenli_ standard

1.0.2

  • Fixed all prefixes to agenli_ per WordPress.org review
  • Replaced all inline script tags with wp_add_inline_script()
  • Added External Services documentation to readme
  • Added Contributors field

1.0.1

  • Fixed class names, AJAX hooks and menu slugs to use agenli_ prefix
  • Fixed inline script tags replaced with wp_add_inline_script()
  • Added readme External Services section

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Exit-intent and delay popup triggers
  • Lead scoring and CSV export
  • CRM webhook integration
  • GA4 tracking ID injection
